retired_2026_09_v5_3.why: v5.3 regenerated assets/moves/<id>-specials.webp in the UNIFIED generation. These files are 2x upscales of the base-generation specials art they replaced, so keeping them would have drawn the OLD generation on the CINEMA 3D specials bank and in the super-portrait close-up while the 2D canvas drew the new one — a bank in two generations, which is the exact fault the wave removes. Deleted rather than left unreferenced; game.js HD_SHEETS no longer lists any -specials key and hdSheetPath answers for the base bank only. Regenerating them from the new SD masters is a separate job; until then the specials bank is SD in both renderers.
